title: JRE 2291 - Bert Kreischer
guestBio: Bert Kreischer is a stand-up comic, podcaster, and actor. He's the host of "The Bertcast" podcast and YouTube cooking program "Something's Burning." He's also the co-host of the "2 Bears, 1 Cave" podcast with fellow comedian Tom Segura. Watch his latest special, "Lucky," on Netflix.
tldr: Bert discusses his comedy career trajectory and what it takes to stay relevant in stand-up
Conversation about his podcasting empire including The Bertcast and 2 Bears 1 Cave with Tom Segura
Bert talks about his Netflix special Lucky and the creative process behind it
Discussion of his cooking show Something's Burning and blending entertainment with culinary content
Personal stories about touring, the comedy circuit, and life on the road as a comedian
Insights into maintaining friendships and collaborations with other comedians like Tom Segura
recap:
Joe Rogan sits down with Bert Kreischer on JRE 2291 for another classic conversation between two comedy titans. Bert comes in with his characteristic energy and enthusiasm, diving into topics that have become familiar territory for anyone who follows his work across multiple platforms. The conversation touches on his various projects and what keeps him motivated in an entertainment landscape that's constantly evolving.

Bert's multi-platform approach to comedy gets explored throughout the episode. Beyond his stand-up work, he's built a significant presence through podcasting with The Bertcast and his collaboration with Tom Segura on 2 Bears 1 Cave. These ventures represent a shift in how comedians can build their brands and maintain direct connections with audiences outside of traditional comedy club settings. Joe and Bert discuss the mechanics of keeping these projects fresh and engaging over extended periods.

The conversation naturally flows toward his Netflix special Lucky, which represents a significant milestone in Bert's career. They discuss the creative decisions that went into the special and what it means to have a polished, recorded version of your material on a platform like Netflix. Bert shares insight into his approach to comedy writing and how he continues to evolve his craft while staying true to what makes his comedy distinctive.

Something's Burning, Bert's cooking show, comes up as an interesting example of how comedians are expanding into adjacent entertainment spaces. The show demonstrates that comedy talent can translate across different mediums when there's genuine interest and passion behind it. Rather than just being another celebrity cooking show, Bert's version maintains the comedic sensibility that his audience expects.

Throughout the episode, Bert opens up about the realities of life on the road as a touring comedian. There's discussion of what it takes to maintain relationships, friendships, and creative partnerships while constantly being in motion. His long-standing collaboration with Tom Segura provides a concrete example of how comedians can build sustainable working relationships that benefit both parties creatively.
